_note: PUBLIC SOURCES FOR THE CONTRACT TERMS PRINTED ON ARTIFACT E. The Atlas cohort has its own cite string and replay URL; the contract terms beside it are not Atlas output and need their own provenance. Each entry names a publisher, the document, what that document is the source of, the date it was read, and the URL. A `url` of null means this build does not hold a citable public document for that entry: the sheet then prints `gap_note` instead of a source, and the terms block is headed `heading_when_missing` rather than `heading_when_held` — TRANSCRIBED and SOURCE RECORD INCOMPLETE, not AS PUBLISHED and VERIFIED, because a transcription nobody can re-open is not a verified citation. Supplying the URL here restores the stronger heading and prints the citation; nothing else changes. scripts/check-collateral.mjs fails the sheet if it prints neither a source nor its gap.

source_quotes.trigger_event: A hurricane makes landfall in the contiguous United States at Category 4 or higher on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale. Landfall means the center of the storm’s circulation crossing the coastline, as determined by the National Hurricane Center.
source_quotes.reference_region: The lower 48 states. Landfalls in Hawaii, Alaska, and US territories do not qualify unless the contract specifies otherwise.
source_quotes.observation_period: Execution date through November 30, 2026, 11:59 p.m. ET.
source_quotes.determination: Storm intensity as classified by the National Hurricane Center at landfall. Category 5 landfalls also qualify.
source_quotes.variants: Regional variants (Gulf Coast only, Florida only) and alternative category thresholds are available and priced accordingly.
source_quotes.publisher_characterisation: Illustrative terms — “Terms for discussion. Not an offer, solicitation, or recommendation to enter into any transaction.”
